reason: I already pay for Wox and a card terminal and my staff barely keep up with those; I'm two waiters short and have no time to roll out a second system, even a free one. 59 lari isn't the problem, the extra setup, another per-transaction fee and public dish ratings on my menu are.
objection: Another system next to my POS means double work for staff and reconciling payments in two places, plus a second card fee on top of what I already pay - and I don't want one bad table rating a dish in front of tourists.
would_change_my_mind: If it plugged straight into Wox so the bill closes itself in my POS with no extra steps for staff, and the payment fee was no higher than my current terminal.
